generated_by: Phase 0 ingestion of the official gazette notification G.S.R. 202(E) dated 7 March 2011 supplied by the user.
note: exact_requirement holds a verbatim excerpt of the English text of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 as published in the Gazette of India. Rule numbers and sub-rules are as printed. No post-2011 amendment notification has been supplied, so no amended text is represented here.

rules.title: Applicability of Chapter II (retail-sale declarations)
rules.exact_requirement: The provisions of this Chapter shall not apply to,- (a) packages of commodities containing quantity of more than 25 kg or 25 litre excluding cement and fertilizer sold in bags up to 50 kg; and (b) packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers.
rules.working_summary: Retail-sale declaration requirements do not apply to packages above 25 kg / 25 litre (cement and fertilizer up to 50 kg excepted) or to packages meant for industrial or institutional consumers.

rules.title: Pre-packed commodity must bear the required declarations
rules.exact_requirement: On and from the commencement of these rules, no person shall pre-pack or cause or permit to be pre-packed any commodity for sale, distribution or delivery unless the package in which the commodity is pre-packed bears thereon, or on a label is securely affixed thereto, such declarations as are required to be made under these rules.
rules.working_summary: Every pre-packed commodity offered for sale, distribution or delivery must carry all declarations required by these rules, on the package or on a securely affixed label.

rules.title: Recommended standard package sizes (Second Schedule)
rules.exact_requirement: The commodities specified in the Second Schedule shall be packed for sale, distribution or delivery in such standard quantities as are specified in that Schedule: Provided that if a commodity specified in the Second Schedule is packed in a size other than that prescribed in that Schedule, a declaration that 'Not a standard pack size under the Legal Metrology (packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011' or 'non standard size under the Legal Metrology (packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011' shall be made prominently on the label of such package.
rules.working_summary: Second Schedule commodities must use the prescribed standard quantities; a non-standard size must carry the prescribed 'non standard size' declaration prominently on the label.

rules.title: Name and address of manufacturer / packer
rules.exact_requirement: Every package shall bear thereon or on label securely affixed thereto, a definite, plain and conspicuous declaration made in accordance with the provisions of this chapter as, to- (a) the name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer and for any imported package the name and address of the importer shall be mentioned.
rules.working_summary: The package must declare the name and address of the manufacturer, and of the packer where different.

rules.title: Name and address of importer on imported packages
rules.exact_requirement: ... and for any imported package the name and address of the importer shall be mentioned.
rules.working_summary: An imported package must declare the name and address of the importer.

rules.title: Common or generic name of the commodity
rules.exact_requirement: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package and in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product shall be mentioned on the package.
rules.working_summary: The package must declare the common or generic name of the commodity; for multi-product packages, the name and number or quantity of each product.

rules.title: Declaration of net quantity
rules.exact_requirement: The net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number of the commodity contained in the package shall be mentioned.
rules.working_summary: The package must declare net quantity in the standard unit of weight or measure, or the number of articles where sold by number.

rules.title: Month and year of manufacture, pre-packing or import
rules.exact_requirement: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned in the package: Provided that for packages containing food articles, the provisions of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954 (37 of 1954) and the rules made there under shall apply ... Provided also that for packages containing cosmetics products, the provisions of the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 shall apply.
rules.working_summary: The package must declare the month and year of manufacture, pre-packing or import. Food articles and cosmetics are governed by their own date-marking laws.

rules.title: Internal consistency of declared dates
rules.exact_requirement: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned in the package.
rules.working_summary: Declared dates must be real calendar dates and internally consistent: a 'best before' or 'use by' date cannot precede the declared date of manufacture or packing. This is a consistency check on the declared dates, applied on the face of the declaration.

rules.title: Retail sale price (MRP) declaration
rules.exact_requirement: the retail sale price of the package; Provided that for packages containing alcoholic beverages or spirituous liquor, the State Excise Laws and the rules made there under shall be applicable within the State in which it is manufactured and where the state excise laws and rules made there under do not provide for declaration of retail sale price, the provisions of these rules shall apply.
rules.working_summary: The package must declare the retail sale price.

rules.title: Form of the retail sale price declaration
rules.exact_requirement: "retail sale price" means the maximum price at which the commodity in packaged form may be sold to the ultimate consumer and the price shall be printed on the package in the manner given below; 'Maximum or Max. retail price Rs...../₹ inclusive of all taxes or in the form MRP Rs / ₹ incl., of all taxes after taking into account the fraction of less than fifty paise to be rounded off to the preceding rupee and fraction of above 50 paise and up to 95 paise to the rounded off to fifty paise.
rules.working_summary: The retail sale price must be printed in the prescribed form — 'Maximum retail price Rs ... inclusive of all taxes' or 'MRP Rs ... incl. of all taxes' — with the prescribed rounding.

rules.title: Dimensions where size is relevant
rules.exact_requirement: Where the sizes of the commodity contained in the package are relevant, the dimensions of the commodity contained in the package and if the dimensions of the different pieces are different, the dimensions of each such different piece shall be mentioned.
rules.working_summary: Where size is relevant to the commodity, dimensions must be declared, separately for each differently sized piece.

rules.title: Consumer-complaint contact details
rules.exact_requirement: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, E-mail address, if available, of the person who can be or the office which can be, contacted, in case of consumer complaints.
rules.working_summary: The package must show the name, address and telephone number (and e-mail, if available) of the consumer-complaint contact.

rules.title: Stickers altering mandatory declarations
rules.exact_requirement: It shall not be permissible to affix individual stickers on the package for altering or making declaration required under these rules: Provided that for reducing the Maximum Retail Price (MRP), a sticker with the revised lower MRP (inclusive of all taxes) may be affixed and the same shall not cover the MRP declaration made by the manufacturer or the packer, as the case may be, on the label of the package.
rules.working_summary: Stickers may not be used to make or alter mandatory declarations. Only a sticker showing a reduced MRP is allowed, and it must not cover the original MRP.

rules.title: Commodities packed as multiple components
rules.exact_requirement: Where a commodity consists of a number of components and these components are packed in two or more units, for sale as a single commodity, the declaration required to be made under sub-rule (1) shall appear on the main package and such package shall also carry information about the other accompanying packages or such declaration may be given on individual packages and intimation to that effect may be given on the main package and if the components are sold as spare parts, all declarations shall be given on each package.
rules.working_summary: For multi-unit commodities, declarations must appear on the main package with information about accompanying packages, or on each individual package with intimation on the main package.

rules.title: Minimum height of numerals and letters on the principal display panel
rules.exact_requirement: (2) The height of any numeral in the declaration required under these rules, on the principal display panel shall not be less than,- (i) as shown in Table-I, if the net quantity is declared in terms of weight or volume; (ii) as shown in Table-II, if the net quantity is declared in terms of length, area or number. (3) The height of letters in the declaration shall not be less than 1 mm height and when blown, formed, molded, embossed or perforated, the height of letters shall not be less than 2 mm. Provided that the width of the letter or numeral shall not be less than one third of its height, except in the case of numeral '1' and letters (i), (I) and (l). TABLE-I — Upto 200g/ml: 1 mm (2 mm when blown/embossed); Above 200g/ml and upto 500g/ml: 2 mm (4 mm); Above 500g/ml: 4 mm (6 mm). TABLE-II — Upto 100 cm2: 1 mm (2 mm); Above 100 cm2 and upto 500 cm2: 2 mm (4 mm); Above 500 cm2 and upto 2500 cm2: 4 mm (6 mm); Above 2500 cm2: 6 mm (6 mm).
rules.working_summary: Numerals must meet the minimum heights in Table I or Table II by net quantity, and letters must be at least 1 mm (2 mm when blown, formed, moulded, embossed or perforated).

rules.title: Declarations to appear on the principal display panel
rules.exact_requirement: Every declaration required to be made under these rules shall appear on the principal display panel. Provided that the area surrounding the quantity declaration shall be free from printed information. (a) above and below by a space equal to at least the height of the numeral in the declaration, and (b) to the left and right by a space at least twice the height of numeral in the declaration.
rules.working_summary: All required declarations must appear on the principal display panel, and the quantity declaration must be surrounded by the prescribed clear space.

rules.title: Declarations to be legible, prominent and contrasting
rules.exact_requirement: Every declaration which is required to be made on a package under these rules shall be -- (a) legible and prominent; (b) numerals of the retail sale price and net quantity declaration shall be printed, painted or inscribed on the package in a colour that contrasts conspicuously with the background of the label.
rules.working_summary: Declarations must be legible and prominent, and the MRP and net-quantity numerals must contrast conspicuously with the background.

rules.title: Completeness of the declared address and corporate name
rules.exact_requirement: ... manufacturer or packer or the Postal Index Number [PIN] Code so that a consumer can identify and locate the manufacturer or packer or importer, as the case may be. (2) The name of the manufacturer or packer or importer shall be the actual corporate name, or if not incorporated, the name under which the business is conducted by such manufacturer or packer or importer in India.
rules.working_summary: The declared address must be complete enough (including PIN code) for a consumer to locate the manufacturer, packer or importer, and the name must be the actual corporate or business name.

rules.title: Net quantity to exclude wrappers and to match what the consumer receives
rules.exact_requirement: (1) In declaring the net quantity of the commodity contained in a package, the weight of wrappers and materials other than the commodity shall be excluded. (2) Where a commodity in a package is not likely to undergo any variation in weight or measure, on account of the environmental conditions, the quantity declared on the package shall correspond to the net quantity which will be received by the consumer, and the declaration of quantity of such package shall not be qualified by the words 'when packed' or the like.
rules.working_summary: The declared net quantity must exclude packaging and must correspond to the quantity actually received by the consumer. Verifying this requires physical measurement, not an image.

rules.title: Units in which quantity must be expressed
rules.exact_requirement: (2) When expressing a quantity less than,- (a) one kilogram, the unit of weight shall be the gram; (b) one metre, the unit of length shall be the centimetre; ... (f) one litre, the unit of volume shall be the millilitre. (3) When expressing a quantity of equal to or more than- (a) one kilogram, the unit of weight shall be the kilogram ... (4) No number called the dozen, score, gross, great gross or the like shall be specified or indicated on any package. (5) Symbol of units:-(i) No system of units other than the International System of Units shall be used in furnishing the net quantity of the package; (ii) For items sold by number the symbol should be N or U.
rules.working_summary: Quantity must be expressed in SI units, using gram/millilitre/centimetre below the base unit and kilogram/litre/metre at or above it. Dozen, score or gross must not be used; items sold by number use N or U.

rules.title: Dimensions of bed-sheets, sarees, towels and similar commodities
rules.exact_requirement: Where a package contains commodities like bed-sheets, hemmed fabric materials, dhoties, sarees, napkins, pillow-covers, towels, table cloths or similar other commodities, the number and the dimensions of finished size of such commodities shall also be declared on the package or on the label affixed thereto: Provided that where the package contains more than one piece of different dimensions, the package shall also contain a declaration as to the dimensions and the retail sale price of each such piece: Provided further that the dimensions of the commodities and the retail sale price thereof shall also be marked on each individual piece.
rules.working_summary: Textile commodities must declare the number and finished dimensions of each piece, with dimensions and retail sale price also marked on each individual piece.

rules.title: Number of usable sheets
rules.exact_requirement: In the case of a package containing sheets like aluminum foil, facial tissues, waxed paper, toilet paper or any other type of sheet, the declaration of quantity on the package shall also include a statement as to the number of usable sheets contained in the package and the dimensions of each such sheet.
rules.working_summary: Sheet products must declare the number of usable sheets and the dimensions of each sheet.

rules.title: Dealers must not sell or display non-compliant packages
rules.exact_requirement: No wholesale dealer or retail dealer or importer shall sell, distribute, deliver, display or store for sale any commodity in the packaged form unless the package complies with in all respects, the provisions of the Act and these rules.
rules.working_summary: A dealer or importer must not sell, display or store for sale any package that does not comply with the Act and these rules.

rules.title: Sale above the declared retail sale price
rules.exact_requirement: No retail dealer or other person including manufacturer, packer, importer and wholesale dealer shall make any sale of any commodity in packed form at a price exceeding the retail sale price thereof.
rules.working_summary: No one may sell a packaged commodity above the declared retail sale price. Evidence is the price charged, not the label alone.

rules.title: Obliterating or altering the declared retail sale price
rules.exact_requirement: (5) No wholesale dealer or retail dealer or other person shall obliterate, smudge or alter the retail sale price, indicated by the manufacturer or the packer or the importer, as the case may be, on the package or on the label affixed thereto. (6) The manufacturer or packer or the importer shall not alter the price on the wrapper once printed and used for packing.
rules.working_summary: The declared retail sale price must not be obliterated, smudged or altered by anyone in the supply chain.

rules.title: Restriction on sale of export packages in India
rules.exact_requirement: An export package shall not be sold in India unless the manufacturer or packer has re-packed or relabeled the commodity in accordance with the provisions contained in Chapter II, and where any export package is sold in India without such re-packing or re-labeling, such package shall be liable to be seized in accordance with the provisions of the Act.
rules.working_summary: An export package may not be sold in India unless re-packed or relabelled to meet Chapter II declarations.

rules.title: Registration of manufacturers, packers and importers
rules.exact_requirement: Every individual, firm, Hindu undivided family, society, company or corporation who or which pre-packs or imports any commodity for sale, distribution or delivery shall make an application, accompanied by a fee of rupees five hundred, to the Director or the Controller for the registration of his or its name and complete address; and every such application shall be made,- (i) in the case of an applicant pre-packing or importing any commodity on the date of commencement of these rules, within a period of ninety days from such commencement; or (ii) in the case of any applicant who or which commences pre-packing or importing of any commodity after the commencement of these rules, within ninety days from the date on which he or it commences such pre-packing.
rules.working_summary: Manufacturers, packers and importers must be registered with the Director or Controller. This is checked against registration records, not from the package image.

rules.title: Retail sale price in advertisements
rules.exact_requirement: Any advertisement mentioning the retail sale price of the pre-packaged commodity shall contain a declaration as to the net quantity or number of the commodity contained in the package and the retail sale price thereof.
rules.working_summary: An advertisement that states the retail sale price must also state the net quantity or number contained in the package.
